early.on_plan: Electrike>=1 and Eelektrik>=1 in play by T3, discard L>=1 (Ultra Ball seed); no Riotous/Zeraora/Cramorant/Tuck-Tail

mid.on_plan: Dynamotor charges a benched Manectric to LLL; first_attack_turn <= 5; first Riotous(330) or Flash Ray

late.on_plan: ping-pong Riotous 1HKO each turn, post_ko_attack_rate high; STOP item-search when deck<=12 to avoid deckout

doctrines.name: A: Manectric ping-pong nuke
doctrines.plan: Charge a benched Mega Manectric to LLL via Dynamotor (bench-only), promote (retreat cost-0 empty active), Riotous 330 discarding all energy; discarded L re-fed by Dynamotor to a 2nd benched Manectric; alternate.
doctrines.discriminating_metric: retreat_count high + energy_attach_share[737] dominant + Riotous(1065) fire rate up vs Flash Ray

doctrines.name: B: Eelektross spread + snipe
doctrines.plan: Mega Eelektross Split Bomb 60x2 + Zeraora 210 to benched ex + Cramorant 120 + Fezandipiti 100 to shave prizes across multiple bodies instead of a single nuke.

doctrines.name: C: Clefairy anti-Colorless tech
doctrines.plan: Keep Lillie's Clefairy ex benched for Fairy Zone (opp Colorless weak to Psychic) and attack with Full Moon Rondo x2 only when a Basic P can be hand-attached.
doctrines.discriminating_metric: play_rate[272 attack 371] and energy_attach_share[272] for Psychic; only vs Colorless-heavy opponents

tensions.balance: Riotous full-discard mode only when discard_L >= 3 AND eelektrik_in_play >= 2; otherwise hold Flash Ray / hand-attach so the engine can re-feed
unconditional search only while deck_count > 12; below that, do not dig if needed piece already in hand
evolve an Eelektrik into Mega Eelektross only when eelektrik_in_play >= 3; never split the accel engine below 2 nodes

hypotheses.claim: Engine auto-uses Meowth ex Tuck Tail (returns self + attached to hand) or Scoop Up Cyclone on its own board, bouncing an evolved Mega (losing all setup) or removing the last Pokemon (auto-loss).
hypotheses.direction: Tuck Tail/Scoop-Up use rate ~0 unless a spare active exists AND a rebuild reason exists; NEVER as the last Pokemon
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Blocking Meowth entirely also loses the Last-Ditch Catch Supporter tutor on bench-drop (that ability is harmless; only the attack is the hazard)
hypotheses.scenario: Reduce our board to a single Meowth ex active (all others KO'd); engine facing an attack decision selects Tuck Tail 60 -> Meowth leaves play -> no Active Pokemon -> immediate loss (reason 3). Also: promote an evolved Mega Manectric with 3 energy, then Scoop Up Cyclone it back, discarding all setup.

hypotheses.claim: Ultra Ball (discard 2) or draw-supporters (Lillie's/Naveen/Judge) discard/shuffle away the core payoff (a Mega Manectric, last Boss's, or the last Lightning energy) held in hand.
hypotheses.metric: trigger_fire[ultra_ball], hand_size_dist, play_rate[737] realized vs drawn
hypotheses.direction: Ultra Ball never discards a Mega/last-L/last-Boss's when no redundant copy exists; Lillie's/Naveen suppressed while holding an unplayed core piece
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: If we forbid all discards the deck cannot pay Ultra Ball's cost nor seed the discard pile with L for Dynamotor -> engine never turns on
hypotheses.scenario: Hand = {Mega Manectric, Ultra Ball, 2 filler}; engine plays Ultra Ball and discards the Mega Manectric to pay the cost, losing the only payoff copy for the turn (Night Stretcher may not be drawn).

hypotheses.claim: Deck loses primarily by deckout: over-digging (4 Lillie's + 4 Ultra Ball + 4 Poke Pad + 3 Poffin + Naveen/Judge/Surfer) against a 10-energy, stall-prone shell exhausts the deck.
hypotheses.direction: loss_share[deckout] below L0 baseline; digging halts when deck thin
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Cutting draw too early bricks the 2-line (Tynamo->Eelektrik AND Electrike->Mega) setup and starves the engine of pieces

hypotheses.claim: Riotous Blasting (the 330 payoff) almost never fires because Dynamotor is bench-only and cannot deliver LLL to the ACTIVE Manectric; the engine settles for Flash Ray/Split Bomb chip damage.
hypotheses.metric: attack usage share Riotous(1065) vs Flash Ray(1064), first_attack_turn, expected_dmg awareness
hypotheses.direction: once engine online (eelektrik>=2, discard_L>=3), Riotous fire rate rises above threshold

threshold.value: riotous_share >= 0.35 of Manectric attacks after T5

hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Forcing Riotous every turn strips energy faster than Dynamotor re-feeds -> the power/economy tension breaks and Manectric sits empty

hypotheses.claim: Dynamotor/hand energy is fed to the wrong body: probes show L piling on Eelektrik(512) and Clefairy(272)/Tynamo(511) instead of a benched Manectric/Eelektross awaiting promotion.
hypotheses.direction: attach share to payoff bodies (737/868) dominates; near-zero L onto Clefairy/Tynamo
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Eelektrik itself needs LLC to use Electric Ball as an emergency attacker; a hard ban on feeding it removes a fallback body
hypotheses.pattern: deck-specific feeding plan (allow-list of loading bodies)

hypotheses.claim: The engine over-evolves Eelektrik into Mega Eelektross (display 190 > Manectric-line pieces) and cannibalizes the Dynamotor engine, leaving too few accel nodes.
hypotheses.metric: play_rate[868], count of Eelektrik(512) remaining in play when 868 evolved, energy supply rate
hypotheses.direction: Eelektross evolution only when eelektrik_in_play >= 3; engine node count stays >= 2
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Never evolving Eelektross removes the spread/paralyze Plan B entirely when Manectric line is dead

hypotheses.claim: Clefairy is treated as an attacker and fed Lightning, but Full Moon Rondo needs a Psychic energy that the L-only accel cannot supply (only 2 basic P, un-accelerated).
hypotheses.metric: energy_attach_share[272], play_rate[272 attack 371], type of energy on 272
hypotheses.direction: no Lightning attached to Clefairy for attacking; Clefairy used as Fairy-Zone ability piece unless a Psychic is hand-available
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Blocking all energy on Clefairy prevents the rare-but-real anti-Colorless Full Moon Rondo x2 line when a Psychic IS available
hypotheses.pattern: type-aware loading (distinguish wall vs loaded by energy TYPE)

hypotheses.claim: Prize race is structurally adverse: both Megas give up 3 prizes each and the entire board is Fighting-weak, so two Mega KOs = game over unless Riotous keeps taking a KO every turn.
hypotheses.metric: loss_share[prize], post_ko_attack_rate, own Mega KO count per game
hypotheses.direction: maintain a 1HKO chain (post_ko_attack_rate high); do not stall behind Flash Ray
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Forcing attacks into unfavorable trades (attacking when we cannot KO) can expose a 3-prize Mega for nothing

hypotheses.claim: Energy-discarding snipers (Zeraora Thunder Raid / Cramorant Spit Shot) are fired indiscriminately, stripping all energy for low value (e.g., Thunder Raid vs an opponent with no benched ex = 0-value self-strip).
hypotheses.metric: play_rate[377,946], gust_targets, energy on self after these attacks
hypotheses.direction: Thunder Raid only when a benched ex target exists AND snipe value > energy loss; Spit Shot only for a board-swinging 120
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Over-gating removes the burst snipe answers to fragile key benched threats

hypotheses.claim: The engine burns turns on zero-damage/stall lines: Tynamo Hold Still (0 dmg heal), Flash Ray as a wall, or non-attacking setup turns, which compounds deckout in a stall.
hypotheses.direction: nonattacking_turn_rate below baseline; Hold Still never chosen as an active attack
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Some setup turns are genuinely correct T1-T2; forcing an attack too early can waste a fragile attacker

hypotheses.claim: Boss's Orders is used without a lethal/high-value follow-up (gusting an active with no KO available), wasting the deck's only pull-and-punish supporters.
hypotheses.direction: Boss's used only when Riotous/snipe can KO the pulled target this turn
hypotheses.risk_of_overtightening: Occasionally gusting to remove a wall/attacker for tempo (not KO) is correct; over-gating loses that

lines.name: pingpong_economy
lines.verified_by: DB: Mega Manectric rc0; Dynamotor attaches L FROM DISCARD to BENCHED (ATTACH_TO probe; targets were scattered -> routed); Riotous 330 = 200+130 discard-all (P0 probe)
lines.setup: T<=4: Eelektrik line online; charge Mega Manectric #1 to LLL (manual + Dynamotor)
lines.loop: Riotous 330 (discards 3L = Dynamotor fuel) -> free retreat (rc0) -> Dynamotor recharges the benched twin from the discard -> twin swings

combo_edges.edge: Riotous discard-all -> discard L = Dynamotor fuel
discard L from hand (Ultra Ball/Trade-like costs) -> accel
